entries.text: 強烈的一擊！\n對神秘障壁造成了巨大的損傷！

entries.text: 這兩隻寶可夢\n都無法逃走了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_Ochakai
entries.text: 舉辦茶會，\n大家一起吃了樹果！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_KagakuHenkaGas
entries.text: 周圍充滿了化學變化氣體！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_KagakuHenkaGas_End
entries.text: 化學變化氣體的效果消失了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_Hoobaru_Failed
entries.text: 沒有攜帶樹果，無法使出招式！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_vsJoker_00
entries.text: [VAR 0x0102(0000)]因為神秘的力量，\n無法使出招式！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_vsJoker_02
entries.text: 現在不是做這種事的時候！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_RankUp2_ATK
entries.text: 我方的\n攻擊大幅提高了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_RankUp2_DEF
entries.text: 我方的\n防禦大幅提高了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_RankUp2_SPATK
entries.text: 我方的\n特攻大幅提高了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_RankUp2_SPDEF
entries.text: 我方的\n特防大幅提高了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_RankUp2_AGI
entries.text: 我方的\n速度大幅提高了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_RankUp2_HIT
entries.text: 我方的\n命中率大幅提高了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_RankUp2_AVOID
entries.text: 我方的\n閃避率大幅提高了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_RankDown2_ATK
entries.text: 我方的\n攻擊大幅降低了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_RankDown2_DEF
entries.text: 我方的\n防禦大幅降低了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_RankDown2_SPATK
entries.text: 我方的\n特攻大幅降低了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_RankDown2_SPDEF
entries.text: 我方的\n特防大幅降低了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_RankDown2_AGI
entries.text: 我方的\n速度大幅降低了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_RankDown2_HIT
entries.text: 我方的\n命中率大幅降低了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_RankDown2_AVOID
entries.text: 我方的\n閃避率大幅降低了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_RankUp_CRITICAL
entries.text: 我方的成員\n全都很有精神！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_Mahi
entries.text: 我方的寶可夢麻痺了，\n不易使出招式！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_MeroMero
entries.text: 我方的寶可夢\n陷入了著迷狀態！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_Sick
entries.text: 我方的寶可夢\n陷入了異常狀態！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_CureSick
entries.text: 我方的寶可夢\n從異常狀態中回復了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_CantEsc
entries.text: 我方的寶可夢\n已經無法逃走了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_Ichamon
entries.text: 我方的寶可夢\n遭到了無理取鬧！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_Sunajigoku
entries.text: 我方的寶可夢\n陷入了流沙地獄！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_HonoNoUzu
entries.text: 我方的寶可夢\n被火焰旋渦困住了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_HP_Recover
entries.text: 我方的寶可夢的\n體力回復了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_PP_Reduce
entries.text: 我方的寶可夢的\nＰＰ減少了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_StealthRock_Hagane
entries.text: 我方周圍\n開始浮現出尖銳的鋼刺！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_StealthRock_Hagane_E
entries.text: 對手周圍\n開始浮現出尖銳的鋼刺！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_StealthRockOff_Hagane
entries.text: 我方周圍的\n鋼刺消失了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_StealthRockOff_Hagane_E
entries.text: 對手周圍的\n鋼刺消失了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_SideEffect_Honoo
entries.text: 我方的寶可夢\n被火焰包圍了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_SideEffect_Honoo_E
entries.text: 對手的寶可夢\n被火焰包圍了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_SideEffect_Iwa
entries.text: 我方的寶可夢\n被岩石包圍了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_SideEffect_Iwa_E
entries.text: 對手的寶可夢\n被岩石包圍了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_vsLegendDemo_00
entries.text: 不知道為什麼無法逃走！？

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_RAID_WazaFailed
entries.text: 被極巨化的力量彈開了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_BallThrowLevelCap
entries.text:
[VAR 0x0102(0000)]
將精靈球彈開了！\c
還沒有能捕捉這隻寶可夢的
道館徽章！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_Ball_NG5
entries.text: 現在還無法使用精靈球！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_Ball_NG7
entries.text: 這可不是個讓人\n有空隙投球的對手……！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_Encount_Wild_strong1
entries.text: 啊！看起來很強的\n[VAR 0x0101(0000)]跑出來了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_Encount_Wild_strong2
entries.text: 嗚哇！看起來很強的\n[VAR 0x0101(0000)]猛撲過來了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_Encount_Wild_Move_strong
entries.text: 啊！看起來很強的\n[VAR 0x0101(0000)]出現了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_Encount_Wild_Ride_strong
entries.text: 嗚哇！看起來很強的\n[VAR 0x0101(0000)]猛撲過來了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_EscapeProhibit2
entries.text: 不能放著失控的寶可夢不管！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_EscapeProhibit3
entries.text: 不能放著失控的蒼響不管！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_EscapeProhibit4
entries.text: 不能放著失控的藏瑪然特不管！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_RAID_Boss_20_you
entries.text: 周圍的極巨力強化了\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]的加油！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_PP_Reduce_E
entries.text: 對手的寶可夢的\nＰＰ減少了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_SideEffect_Kusa
entries.text: 我方的寶可夢\n被鞭子的猛擊包圍了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_SideEffect_Kusa_E
entries.text: 對手的寶可夢\n被鞭子的猛擊包圍了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_SideEffect_Mizu
entries.text: 我方的寶可夢\n被水流包圍了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_GShockWave_SideEffect_Mizu_E
entries.text: 對手的寶可夢\n被水流包圍了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_Encount_kimawari
entries.text: 啊！道館測驗的\n向日花怪撲過來了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_Ball_NG_kimawari
entries.text: 向日花怪是道館的寶可夢！\n無法捕捉！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_Encount_Yadon
entries.text: 啊！是飛～毛腿呆呆獸！\n打倒牠，搶回修行套裝吧！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_Ball_NG_Yadon
entries.text: 飛～毛腿呆呆獸\n是師傅的寶可夢！\r\n無法捕捉！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_Chika_02
entries.text: 決定不捕捉[VAR 0x0101(0000)]\n就繼續前進！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_RAID_Boss_yell_02
entries.text: 我方全體的\n攻擊和特攻提高了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_RAID_Boss_yell_03
entries.text: 我方全體的\n防禦和特防提高了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_RAID_Boss_yell_04
entries.text: 我方全體的\n體力回復了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_RAID_Boss_charge_05
entries.text: 用太晶化阻止[VAR 0x0101(0000)]的行動吧！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_RAID_Boss_final_01
entries.text: 感受到相當驚人的能量！\n時間已經所剩無幾……！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_RAID_Boss_action_01
entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0000)]將自己身上的\n負面效果消除了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_RAID_Boss_action_02
entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0000)]將我方的能力變化\n和特性效果消除了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_RAID_Boss_action_03
entries.text: 太晶珠的蓄能被[VAR 0x0101(0000)]奪走了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_RAID_terracecount
entries.text: 太晶珠的蓄能不夠……！\n再攻擊[VAR 0x0200(0000)]次似乎就會蓄足能量！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_RAID_Boss_escape
entries.text: 不行！在強敵的面前\n找不到逃走的空檔！！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_JOBAN_LEGEND_01
entries.text: 找不到可交換寶可夢的空檔……！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_JOBAN_LEGEND_02
entries.text: 實在不是會讓人逃走的對手……！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_JOBAN_LEGEND_03
entries.text: 手在發抖，無法從包包拿出道具……！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_LASTBATTLE_01
entries.text: 派不出寶可夢，無法戰鬥……！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_LASTBATTLE_02
entries.text: 球被封鎖了，\n無法派出寶可夢！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_LASTBATTLE_03
entries.text: 球被封鎖了，\n無法使用道具！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_LASTBATTLE_04
entries.text: 自己逃走的話，\n大家會陷入危險……！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_BACKATTACK_01
entries.text: 野生的[VAR 0x0101(0000)]\n因突如其來的襲擊而無法行動！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_IrekaeConfirm_noTRTYPE
entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]\n正準備派出[VAR 0x0102(0001)]。\r\n要替換寶可夢嗎？

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_WinTrainer_lastbattle
entries.text: 成功戰勝了樂園防衛程式！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_mew_battle_01
entries.text: 面對強敵，\n夢幻拿出全力了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_lastbattle_message_01
entries.text: 太晶能量被太樂巴戈斯吸收了！

entries.label: BTL_STRID_STD_lastbattle_message_02
entries.text: 太晶的力量使太樂巴戈斯的\n屬性發生了變化！
